title: Falcon 40B Launch
summary: The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) announced Falcon LLM on March 15, 2023 as a 40-billion-parameter foundational large language model. TII stated that the model was trained on one trillion tokens and was built by its AI and Digital Science Research Center's AI Cross-Center Unit.
significance: A documented public launch milestone for the Falcon 40B large language model from the Technology Innovation Institute in the United Arab Emirates.
organizations: AI and Digital Science Research Center

verification.note: TII's first-party March 15, 2023 announcement directly documents the launch date, the Falcon LLM identity, its 40-billion-parameter scale, training on one trillion tokens, and the TII/AIDRC team attribution. TII's May 25, 2023 open-source announcement independently refers back to Falcon being first unveiled in March 2023 and documents the later open-source milestone. This candidate is restricted to the March 15 launch milestone. Promotional benchmark or priority language is not adopted as a historical claim, and no system-birth date, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edge is inferred.
